issues.summary: The streak badge's words are drawn in a typed brown (Color(0xFF8A4B00)) instead of on-action-secondary, so they ignore dark mode and the High contrast variant.

consequences.note: The typed brown is about 2:1 on the badge's dark sand (it needs 4.5:1), so every streak on Today (the / route and TodayPreview) fails in dark mode, in both variants and both directions.

issues.summary: The habit page's padding (18 dp) isn't on the spacing scale; the other screens use MotifSpace.s4 at the sides.
Habit rows have a typed 12 dp corner, which isn't one of the radius roles (the guide gives rows radius.lg).
The habit page's best streak sets fontSize = 15.sp on the body role, a size that isn't one of the text roles.
A ticked row's border changes colour with a raw FastOutSlowInEasing instead of a MotifEasing role.
Sign in's title hard-codes FontFamily.Serif over the title role, so it is a serif unlike every other heading, and in Arabic it drops the theme's Readex Pro for the phone's serif.
The generated theme code was edited by hand (MotifRadius.md changed from 14 to 16 dp), so it no longer matches the design guide, and the next motif tokens will undo it.
Sign in's line under the title is text-secondary faded to 50%, so it's hard to read: about 2.1:1 in light mode and 3.1:1 in dark (2.8:1 and 4.4:1 in the High contrast variant; it needs 4.5:1).
Today's "Add a habit" button is squeezed into 32 dp beside Sign out, so people can tap it only 40 dp wide; phones need 44×44 (Material's is 48).
Today's Sign out button is an icon with contentDescription = null, so a screen reader can't say what it is.

Each habit row is crammed: no padding above or below, the name 8 dp from the row's edge and against its streak badge, and names cut to one line, so the list reads as a block and long names in either language are lost.

Add a habit's main action is a stock OutlinedButton at the end of the form (outlined, smaller, Material's own shape) instead of AppButton's full-width primary style, so the one thing to do on the screen looks like a supporting action, unlike every other main action.

Today has no empty state: someone with no habits sees only the Today heading over the colours switch (TodayEmptyPreview), with no words saying why and no way to add one but a small icon in the app bar.

The habit page's streak puts the gap after its number with Modifier.absolutePadding(left = …), so in Arabic (right to left) the gap is on the wrong side: the number touches the words beside it. It should be padding(start = …) or the Row's spacing.

The back button uses Icons.Filled.ArrowBack, which doesn't mirror, so in Arabic it points forward instead of back on every page below Today: a habit's page and Add a habit. It should be Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack.
